messages:
fran: Heads-up: our CI started failing after upgrading to python-sdk 0.9.0. mypy errors originate from autogenerated models + clients.

sergio: can you paste the top error?

fran: snippet from CI:
```
services/payments/api_client.py:120: error: Expression of type \"str\" cannot be assigned to declared type \"Optional[str]\"  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 39 source files)
```

fran: client code does `obj.title = resp['title']` and mypy complains because generated domain model has `title: Optional[str] = None` while resp[...] is inferred as str. Previously we generated TypedDict response stubs so this didn't surface.

oliver: runtime is fine, it's strictly static checks right?

fran: yes only type check failures. tests pass.

sergio: thank you — this aligns with an internal change: we switched to Pydantic models for domain objects but left response stubs as Mapping[str, Any]. Solutions: A) emit TypedDicts for responses, B) widen model fields to Any, C) add `# type: ignore` or casts where assignments happen, D) add generator flag to opt into typed responses.

oliver: (C) and (B) are undesirable. I'd prefer D so teams can opt in without breaking semver.

sergio: agreed. I'll prototype a `--typed-responses` CLI flag that emits TypedDicts for operation responses and updates client stubs accordingly. Keep it opt-in for 0.9.x, flip default in 1.0.0.

fran: also saw multiple places where embeddings fields are `List[Any]`. For numeric embeddings we should emit `List[float]` when schema indicates \"number\". It caused confusion compared to our Go SDK which uses []float64.

sergio: good point — I'll add a heuristic: if schema item type == \"number\" -> List[float], if integer -> List[int], else List[Any].

devx-bot: Branch pushed: feature/typed-responses (repo: python-sdk)

fran: please include a minimal async sample showing TypedDict usage with AsyncClient. our onboarding docs need an async typed example.

sergio: will include a samples/async_typed_responses.py showing `async with RedwoodAsyncClient() as c:` and imports of generated TypedDicts, plus mypy.ini and pyrightconfig.json examples.

ci-bot: CI triggered: feature/typed-responses — mypy stage queued

oliver: thanks. one more request: add `from __future__ import annotations` at top of generated modules to reduce forward-ref issues and speed up import time.

sergio: noted, adding that too. planning a WIP PR later today with tests that run both mypy and pyright over a tiny sample package.

fran: interim workaround for other teams: `from typing import cast, Optional` then `obj.title = cast(Optional[str], resp.get('title'))` but we shouldn't recommend that long-term.

sergio: totally. PR will include changelog entry, migration snippet, and CI job that runs both linters. ETA EOD PST — will post link here when ready.

fran: appreciated, ping when it's up :thumbsup:
